items.prompt: THE BLACK TIDE — SORCERESS EMERGENCE A cinematic, photorealistic neo-noir film still featuring the same beautiful adult blonde sorceress emerging waist-deep from a vast pool of opaque black liquid on an ancient seaside terrace. She has long, vibrant, wet blonde hair, striking dark blue eyes, pale skin, and a calm, formidable expression. She is powerful without theatrical exaggeration; her presence is quiet, dangerous, and supernatural. She is drenched and streaked with the black liquid hea to toe WARDROBE: A small, simple, fitted black ancient-style top with narrow straps, elegant and minimal, appropriate to a dark fantasy character. A medium-length, distressed ivory-black miniskirt torn and tattered, made of aged, water-soaked fabric with irregular torn edges, separated strips, and naturally hanging folds. The wet fabric clings and moves under its own weight. The skirt is visibly damaged by time and the elements, not deliberately arranged for display. No modern clothing, no armor, no excessive accessories. ACTION AND ENVIRONMENT: Med close, She is slowly rising out of the black liquid, with the liquid reaching her waist. Her hands hang naturally at her sides, fingertips partially submerged. Concentric ripples spread outward from her body. Thick black fluid streams from the torn skirt in long, gravity-driven trails. Droplets fall from her hair and arms. The liquid has a reflective, almost oil-black surface, with subtle silver highlights and faint supernatural movement beneath it. Her posture is upright and composed, as if the sea itself is yielding to her presence. An immense weathered stone balcony extends in front of her. Broad ancient stone steps descend from the terrace into the black pool, partly submerged. Beyond the balcony, a violent ocean crashes against a rugged coastline. The pool and balcony are jutting out from the main structure that is offscreen, massive rocks connected to a massive temple off screen behind her Huge storm waves, sea spray, distant cliffs, and a turbulent sky establish a bleak, mythic atmosphere. The left side contains a continuous, coherent expanse of stormy sea, stone ledge, and sky.
